title: sse: fix streaming chunking & framing (partial JSON, delimiter ordering, token/event ordering)
author: Priya Shah
description: Fixes multiple issues in the SSE streaming stack that were causing partial/invalid JSON events, wrong delimiter ordering, and occasional token/event reordering when proxied through the OpenAI-compatible adapter. Motivation: customer reports and internal canaries showed intermittent invalid JSON payloads in streaming responses (partial "partial" chunks), and downstream clients (OpenAI-compatible SDKs) expect a strict delimiter/event token ordering. Changes included a focused refactor of the SSE framer buffer state machine, canonicalized delimiter emission order, and stronger invariants around partial JSON flushing and retry on mid-frame disconnects. Also tightened the OpenAI compatibility adapter to preserve event boundaries when bridging Redwood framing to the OpenAI event format. Includes unit and integration tests that reproduce the previous failure modes and adds a flaky test harness for streaming reordering. See linked Linear tasks and notes for rollout strategy.

release_notes: Fixes SSE streaming framing that could emit partial/invalid JSON and cause event/token reordering when proxied through the OpenAI compatibility layer. Improves robustness around mid-frame disconnects. Backported to release/2024-10.
